description: Verified exam notes for 21 November 2026 covering public health, internal security, digital governance, biotechnology, environment, labour, infrastructure, international cooperation and Tamil Nadu.

stories.title: India crosses one crore HPV vaccine doses under the national campaign
stories.summary: The Union Health Ministry reported that more than one crore HPV vaccine doses had been administered in under nine months of the National HPV Vaccination Campaign. The campaign, launched in February 2026, offers a free, voluntary single dose with parental consent to eligible 14-year-old girls at designated government health facilities; the ministry described the milestone as nearly 87% coverage of the identified annual cohort.
key_facts: The identified annual target cohort is approximately 1.2 crore 14-year-old girls, based on Registrar General of India 2021 population estimates.
Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Mizoram, Madhya Pradesh and Bihar were reported to have reached 100% of their identified target populations.
U-WIN supports beneficiary tracking, slot booking and digital vaccination certificates.
Persistent infection with high-risk HPV types causes the vast majority of cervical cancer cases.
stories.exam_link: Revise preventive healthcare, HPV and cervical cancer, adolescent immunisation, U-WIN and the distinction between vaccination coverage and disease elimination.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, PIB, 21 November 2026

stories.title: NCG VISHWAS launched for multilingual cancer-patient education
stories.summary: The Union Health Secretary launched NCG VISHWAS at the National Cancer Grid Annual Meeting in Mumbai. The AI-enabled patient-education initiative provides clinician-reviewed material on breast, cervical and oral cancers in Hindi, Marathi, Tamil and English. The event also highlighted consent-based linkage of screening records with ABHA IDs to support continuity of care.
key_facts: VISHWAS expands to Videos to Support Health, Wellness, Awareness and Self-care.
The National Cancer Grid is a network of more than 400 cancer centres, research institutions and patient groups.
Around 99 crore ABHA IDs and about 100 crore linked health records were reported under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission.
The initiative covers prevention, diagnosis, treatment and long-term care.
stories.exam_link: Connect the National Cancer Grid with ABDM, ABHA, interoperable health records, informed consent and the role of AI in public-health communication.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, PIB, 21 November 2026

stories.title: NCB and US DEA report outcomes from Operation Monsoon Thunder
stories.summary: India's Narcotics Control Bureau and the United States Drug Enforcement Administration jointly conducted Operation Monsoon Thunder against a transnational drug-trafficking network. The official release reported six arrests across four Indian cities, the identification of approximately 3,000 parcels involving nearly 500,000 tablets, data-sharing concerning more than 59,000 US subjects and interception of two live consignments by the DEA. Further investigation remains ongoing.
key_facts: Operation Monsoon Thunder is a joint NCB-US DEA law-enforcement operation.
The reported parcels had been shipped within the United States.
Investigators are continuing to identify masterminds and dropshippers, trace financial proceeds and establish wider international links.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Narcotics Control Bureau, transnational organised crime, international police cooperation and India's obligations under international drug-control conventions.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Home Affairs, PIB, 21 November 2026

stories.title: Seven JIPMER facilities worth ₹172.27 crore dedicated to the nation
stories.summary: The Union Health Minister dedicated seven healthcare, research and student-care facilities at JIPMER, Puducherry, with a combined investment of ₹172.27 crore. Completed facilities include a cardiac catheterisation laboratory complex, a TrueBeam linear accelerator, a Centre for Research, Innovation and Entrepreneurship and student-care infrastructure. Separate multi-organ transplantation and trauma-care facilities mentioned at the event remain proposals rather than completed projects.
key_facts: JIPMER is an Institution of National Importance under the Union Health Ministry.
The Centre for Research, Innovation and Entrepreneurship cost ₹30.28 crore and includes genomics, proteomics and metabolomics facilities.
Dhanvantari House is a 400-bed boys' hostel built at ₹42.26 crore.
The minister also addressed JIPMER's 15th convocation, where 816 students received degrees.
stories.exam_link: Revise Institutions of National Importance, tertiary healthcare, medical research infrastructure and the distinction between dedication of completed assets and future institutional plans.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, PIB, 21 November 2026

stories.title: GeM and TICCI partner to support tribal entrepreneurs
stories.summary: Government e Marketplace signed an MoU with the Tribal Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry to widen tribal enterprises' access to public procurement. The partnership provides for outreach, onboarding assistance, training, mentoring, issue resolution and monitoring; it is an enabling arrangement, not a procurement quota or guarantee of government orders.
key_facts: The MoU was signed on 20 November 2026 and announced by PIB on 21 November.
TICCI will identify and mobilise tribal entrepreneurs and develop trainers and mentors.
GeM will supply training resources, onboarding facilitation and capacity-building support.
stories.exam_link: Study GeM as the national public-procurement portal and link inclusive market access with tribal entrepreneurship, transparency and digital government procurement.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, PIB, 21 November 2026

stories.title: BHASHINI demonstrates multilingual AI for clinical workflows
stories.summary: The Digital India BHASHINI Division concluded its participation at the Global Digital Health Summit 2026 after demonstrating multilingual speech and language tools for healthcare. Use cases included voice-based clinical documentation at JIPMER, doctor-patient communication at AIIMS and conversion of spoken clinical notes into text in the Armed Forces' Dhanwantri system.
key_facts: BHASHINI operates under the Digital India Corporation in MeitY.
The platform supports 36 Indian text languages, 23 Indian voice languages and 35 international languages.
The ecosystem was reported to have recorded more than 11 billion inferences and about 24 million inferences daily.
The summit theme was Implementing Artificial Intelligence – AI in Action.
stories.exam_link: Revise Digital India, language AI, speech-to-text, translation, digital public infrastructure and the use of indigenous language technologies in public services.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, PIB, 21 November 2026

stories.title: BRIC sets out bioeconomy ambitions for 2030 and 2047
stories.summary: At the fourth annual general meeting of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council, the Union Science and Technology Minister reiterated ambitions for an Indian bioeconomy of USD 300 billion by 2030 and USD 1 trillion by 2047. These figures are policy ambitions, not completed outcomes; the meeting reviewed research collaboration, shared infrastructure, governance reforms and translation of research into usable technologies.
key_facts: BRIC stands for Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council.
India's bioeconomy was described as having grown from about USD 10 billion to more than USD 195 billion.
The BRIC governance handbook on its memorandum, rules, regulations and bye-laws was launched at the meeting.
The council integrates biotechnology institutions while retaining their scientific strengths.
stories.exam_link: Link biotechnology policy with the bioeconomy, research translation, shared scientific infrastructure, DBT institutions and innovation-led growth.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Science and Technology, PIB, 21 November 2026

stories.title: CSIR-NEERI workshop focuses on airshed management in the Indo-Gangetic Plain
stories.summary: CSIR-NEERI convened experts from government departments and CSIR laboratories to examine clean-air and climate-resilience measures for Delhi-NCR and the wider Indo-Gangetic Plain. Discussions covered airshed management, monitoring networks, source-specific technologies, health impacts and AI-supported decisions. A technical committee and a policy brief were proposed; neither should be treated as an already implemented programme.
key_facts: NEERI is the National Environmental Engineering Research Institute under CSIR.
The workshop was held at NEERI's Delhi Regional Centre in Naraina.
The proposed policy brief is intended to identify priority interventions, technology readiness, demonstration projects and collaboration opportunities.
Experts discussed a scientific approach to planning the Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring network.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Indo-Gangetic Plain, airsheds, transboundary air pollution, ambient-air monitoring and the difference between an expert recommendation and an adopted policy.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Science and Technology, PIB Mumbai, 21 November 2026

stories.title: Nitish Setu dedicated as part of ₹34,470-crore Bihar development programme
stories.summary: The Prime Minister inaugurated, dedicated and laid foundation stones for projects worth around ₹34,470 crore at Vaishali, Bihar. The completed six-lane Dargah-Bidupur crossing over the Ganga, named Nitish Setu, was dedicated to the nation. Because the package combines completed works with foundation stones, the entire ₹34,470 crore should not be described as completed infrastructure.
key_facts: The Nitish Setu project is approximately 19.7 km long, including a 9.7 km main bridge and 10 km of approach roads.
It connects Kachhi Dargah on NH-22 in Patna district with Bidupur on NH-322 in Vaishali district.
The bridge cost around ₹4,280 crore and provides an additional Ganga crossing between North and South Bihar.
The wider programme covers roads, energy, urban infrastructure, water resources, education, healthcare and transport.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Ganga basin, Bihar's transport geography, cable-stayed and extradosed bridge concepts, national highways and how infrastructure packages combine inaugurations with proposed works.

stories.title: Tenkasi intensifies avian-influenza surveillance along Kerala border
stories.summary: The Tenkasi District Administration announced surveillance along the Tamil Nadu-Kerala border to prevent the spread of avian influenza. The same-day official notice confirms preventive monitoring; it does not, by itself, report a newly confirmed outbreak in Tenkasi or provide case, culling or human-infection figures.
key_facts: The district notice was published on 21 November 2026.
Avian influenza is a viral disease chiefly affecting birds, with certain strains capable of infecting other animals and humans.
Border surveillance is a biosecurity measure used to detect and limit animal-disease movement.
stories.exam_link: Connect the development with veterinary public health, zoonoses, One Health, livestock biosecurity and Tamil Nadu's geography along the Kerala border.
stories.source_title: Tenkasi District Administration, Government of Tamil Nadu, 21 November 2026

stories.title: States and Union Territories review implementation of the four Labour Codes
stories.summary: A two-day Chintan Shivir of Labour and Employment Ministers of States and Union Territories began at Gandhinagar. The meeting marked one year since the Labour Codes came into effect and reviewed implementation, EPFO and ESIC reforms, employment initiatives, unorganised-worker social security, labour statistics and trust-based electronic compliance.
key_facts: The Chintan Shivir was scheduled for 21-22 November 2026 at Mahatma Mandir, Gandhinagar.
The four Labour Codes consolidate numerous central labour laws into codes on wages, industrial relations, social security and occupational safety, health and working conditions.
Day-one sessions included implementation status, EPFO reforms, ESIC reforms and social security for unorganised workers.
stories.exam_link: Revise the four Labour Codes, labour as a Concurrent List subject, EPFO, ESIC and Centre-State coordination in labour administration.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Labour and Employment, PIB, 21 November 2026

stories.title: BRICS Women Leaders Summit opens at Banasthali Vidyapith
stories.summary: The BRICS Women Leaders Summit opened at Banasthali Vidyapith in Rajasthan for a three-day programme from 21 to 23 November 2026. The Lok Sabha Speaker's inaugural address emphasised women-led development, responsible technology and cooperation on climate change, terrorism, cybercrime and drug trafficking. The summit is a deliberative forum rather than a treaty-making meeting.
key_facts: Participants include women parliamentarians, policymakers, academics, entrepreneurs and delegates from BRICS and partner countries.
The agenda includes women's political participation, capacity building, digital security and cyber safety.
Banasthali Vidyapith is located in Tonk district, Rajasthan.
stories.exam_link: Revise BRICS as an intergovernmental cooperation forum, parliamentary diplomacy, women-led development and the distinction between summit dialogue and binding international law.

mcqs.question: The National HPV Vaccination Campaign discussed in the 21 November 2026 release primarily targets which group?
mcqs.explanation: The campaign offers a free, voluntary single dose, with parental consent, to eligible 14-year-old girls at government health facilities.

mcqs.question: NCG VISHWAS is primarily designed to provide which service?
mcqs.explanation: NCG VISHWAS supplies clinician-reviewed multilingual videos covering cancer prevention, diagnosis, treatment and long-term care.

mcqs.question: Operation Monsoon Thunder was jointly conducted by which agencies?
mcqs.explanation: The operation was a coordinated action by India's Narcotics Control Bureau and the United States Drug Enforcement Administration.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes the JIPMER announcement of 21 November 2026?
options: Seven completed facilities worth ₹172.27 crore were dedicated
A new JIPMER campus was opened in Delhi
All announced transplant facilities were already operational
JIPMER was converted into a private university
mcqs.explanation: Seven facilities worth ₹172.27 crore were dedicated; the multi-organ transplant and trauma-care centres mentioned separately were future plans.

mcqs.question: The GeM-TICCI MoU seeks to improve market access for which group?
mcqs.explanation: The partnership focuses on outreach, onboarding and capacity building for tribal entrepreneurs and enterprises in public procurement.

mcqs.question: Digital India BHASHINI functions under which Union ministry?
options: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
mcqs.explanation: The Digital India BHASHINI Division operates through Digital India Corporation under MeitY.

mcqs.question: Which pair correctly states the bioeconomy ambitions highlighted at BRIC's 2026 AGM?
options: USD 100 billion by 2030 and USD 500 billion by 2047
USD 300 billion by 2030 and USD 1 trillion by 2047
USD 1 trillion by 2030 and USD 3 trillion by 2047
USD 195 billion by 2030 and USD 300 billion by 2047
mcqs.explanation: The minister described ambitions of USD 300 billion by 2030 and USD 1 trillion by 2047; these are targets, not completed outcomes.

mcqs.question: In the air-pollution workshop, an 'airshed' approach is most closely associated with what?
options: Managing pollution across a shared atmospheric region
mcqs.explanation: Airshed management treats air pollution across the broader region in which emissions and atmospheric movement interact, rather than within one administrative boundary.

mcqs.question: Nitish Setu connects Kachhi Dargah in Patna district with which location?
mcqs.explanation: The Ganga crossing links Kachhi Dargah on NH-22 with Bidupur on NH-322 in Vaishali district.

mcqs.question: What did the Tenkasi District notice of 21 November 2026 confirm?
options: Preventive avian-influenza surveillance along the Kerala border
Permanent closure of all border roads
mcqs.explanation: The notice confirmed surveillance to prevent spread; it did not announce a new local human outbreak or provide culling figures.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not one of India's four Labour Codes?
mcqs.explanation: The four codes concern wages, industrial relations, social security, and occupational safety, health and working conditions.

mcqs.question: The 2026 BRICS Women Leaders Summit opened at which institution?
mcqs.explanation: The summit opened at Banasthali Vidyapith in Tonk district, Rajasthan.

mcqs.question: Which digital identifier was highlighted for linking screening records to support continuity of cancer care?
mcqs.explanation: The Health Secretary emphasised consent-based linkage with the Ayushman Bharat Health Account identifier.

mcqs.question: Which statement about the ₹34,470-crore Bihar programme is accurate?
options: Every project in the package was completed on the same day
The package combined inaugurations, dedications and foundation stones
It excluded energy and urban infrastructure
mcqs.explanation: The programme included both completed assets and works for which foundation stones were laid, across several sectors.

mcqs.question: Which institution organised the Clean Air and Climate Resilience workshop for the Indo-Gangetic Plain?
mcqs.explanation: The workshop was organised by the CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute at its Delhi Regional Centre.
